title: Final Review
ringkas: Latihan campuran semua materi sampai kelas 12
goals: mengulang **tense**, modal, passive, conditional, dan reported speech
mengulang **jenis teks** dari Kelas 10 dan 11: descriptive, recount, procedure, narrative, exposition, explanation, news item, letter
mengulang strategi **membaca** dan pola soal **tata bahasa**
mengerjakan **latihan campuran** dari seluruh materi sampai Kelas 12

lesson.text: Selamat, ini **unit terakhir**! Di sini kamu **mengulang semuanya**: tense, jenis teks, tata bahasa ujian, dan percakapan. Baca rangkuman, lalu kerjakan Latihan dan Kuis campuran. Kamu sudah menempuh perjalanan panjang dari Kelas 7 sampai 12. 🎉

lesson.title: 1. Rangkuman tense
table: will + V1 / be going to + V1

lesson.title: 2. Rangkuman pola kalimat
table: can, must, should, may, will + kata kerja dasar
to be + V3: [[The room is cleaned.]] / [[was built]] / [[has been finished]] / [[will be opened]]
if + had V3, would have V3
tense bergeser ke belakang: [[am → was]], [[will → would]]
taller than, the tallest; more beautiful, the most beautiful

lesson.title: 4. Ungkapan penting
table: [[Tell me about yourself.]] / [[I am a quick learner.]]
[[I am writing to apply for ...]] / [[I look forward to hearing from you.]]

lesson.title: 5. Strategi ujian
lesson.text:
1. **Baca soal dulu**, lalu skim teks dan scan kata kunci.
2. **Coret** pilihan yang jelas salah.
3. Untuk tata bahasa, cek **subjek, petunjuk waktu, bentuk kata kerja**.
4. Waspadai kata ekstrem: *always, never, all, only*.
5. Atur waktu: lewati soal sulit, **periksa ulang** di akhir.

lesson.title: Terus berlatih
lesson.text: Dengarkan lagu, tonton video, dan baca teks berbahasa Inggris setiap hari. Tulis lima kata baru per hari dan pakai dalam kalimat. Klik kata berwarna di unit sebelumnya untuk melatih pelafalan.

lines.en: If we read the questions carefully, we will do well.
lines.id: Jika kita membaca soal dengan teliti, kita akan berhasil.

items: Passive, conditional, dan reported speech: perhatikan **bentuk kata kerja**.
Teks: kenali **tujuan** dan **struktur** tiap jenis teks.
Ujian: baca soal dulu, eliminasi, cek ulang.
Terima kasih sudah belajar sampai akhir. Teruslah berlatih! 🎉

Tahun lalu, sekelompok siswa SMA Pelita memulai proyek perpustakaan mini. Mereka mengumpulkan lebih dari dua ratus buku bekas dari guru, orang tua, dan tetangga. Lalu mereka memperbaiki buku yang rusak dan menaruhnya di rak di koridor sekolah.
Sejak perpustakaan dibuka, banyak siswa meminjam buku saat istirahat. Jika proyek ini berlanjut, sekolah mungkin akan menambah sudut baca tahun depan. Kepala sekolah mengatakan bahwa dia bangga pada para siswa dan bahwa proyek itu telah meningkatkan budaya membaca di sekolah.

read.text:
Last year, a group of students at SMA Pelita started a mini library project. They collected more than two hundred used books from teachers, parents, and neighbors. Then they repaired the damaged books and placed them on shelves in the school corridor.
Since the library opened, many students have borrowed books during their break. If the project continues, the school will probably add a reading corner next year. The principal said that she was proud of the students and that the project had improved the reading culture at school.
read.title: Final Review: The Mini Library Project

Yth. Redaktur, saya menulis untuk menyampaikan keprihatinan saya tentang sampah di sepanjang bantaran sungai kita. Setiap akhir pekan, pengunjung membuang botol plastik dan bungkus makanan ke air. Akibatnya, sungai menjadi kotor dan bau.
Menurut saya, pemerintah daerah sebaiknya menyediakan lebih banyak tempat sampah dan memasang papan peringatan di dekat sungai. Selain itu, warga sebaiknya ikut kerja bakti bulanan. Jika tidak ada tindakan, sungai akan rusak secara permanen. Hormat saya, Hendra

read.text:
Dear Editor, I am writing to express my concern about the rubbish along our riverbank. Every weekend, visitors throw plastic bottles and food wrappers into the water. As a result, the river has become dirty and smelly.
In my opinion, the local government should provide more rubbish bins and place a warning sign near the river. Furthermore, residents ought to join a monthly clean-up. If nothing is done, the river will be damaged permanently. Yours faithfully, Hendra

Sabtu lalu, sekolah kami mengadakan pameran sains. Banyak siswa telah menyiapkan proyeknya selama berminggu-minggu, dan sebagian masih memperbaiki model mereka ketika pengunjung tiba. Sekelompok gadis mempresentasikan mesin yang membersihkan air sungai.

read.text:
Last Saturday, our school held a science fair. Many students had been preparing their projects for weeks, and some of them were still fixing their models when the visitors arrived. A group of girls presented a machine that cleans river water.
Their project has been praised by several judges, and it will be sent to a national competition next month. If they win, they will receive a scholarship. The students say that they have learned more from this project than from any textbook.
read.title: Review: The Science Fair

Minggu lalu, sekolah kami menjadi tuan rumah lomba debat. Tim dari sepuluh sekolah telah mempersiapkan diri selama berbulan-bulan, dan topiknya adalah "Haruskah siswa memakai ponsel di kelas?" Ketika babak final berlangsung, aula benar-benar hening.

read.text:
Last week, our school hosted a debate competition. Teams from ten schools had been preparing for months, and the topic was "Should students use phones in class?" While the final round was taking place, the hall was completely silent.
Our team has won second place, and we have been invited to the national round next month. If we practice every day, we will have a good chance. Our coach says that if we had prepared more, we would have won first place, so we are working harder now.
read.title: Review: The Debate Competition

Tom: Di mana kamu menemukan alamatnya? Rina: Dia menulisnya di peta, yang masih kusimpan. Seandainya aku tidak bertemu dengannya, kita pasti tersesat. Tom: Dia orang yang membuat sebuah kota terasa ramah.

read.text:
Rina: Do you remember the woman who helped us at the station? Tom: Yes, she was the one whose bag had a green label. She gave us the map that we needed. Rina: I'm writing a thank-you note to her, which I will send tomorrow.
Tom: Where did you find her address? Rina: She wrote it on the map, which I still have. If I hadn't met her, we would have been lost. Tom: She is the kind of person who makes a city feel friendly.
read.title: The Person Who Helped Me
